description_full: Omai Gold Mines Corp. engages in the acquisition, exploration, evaluation, and development of mineral properties. The company explores for gold and precious mineral deposits. It holds a 100% interests in the Omai prospecting license that covers an area of 4,590 acres located in the Potaro mining district of Guyana. The company is based in Toronto, Canada.
